subject: [hw] IP -> lead: vcodecd done host-side (316 checks); two blockers: client DMA PA and iOS archive
body:
IP is in the tree and green host-side.

  bash gpu/hwcodec/daemon/test/run_tests.sh -> N2TEST IP PASS 316/316
  bash gpu/hwcodec/build_ios.sh -> IOS BUILD OK (rwjpeg_tool binary + vcodecd/n2vcd_srv/JPEG objects for arm64-apple-ios16.0)
  bash gpu/hwcodec/install/stage.sh dev --partial --host-test -> STAGE HOST TEST OK

The test is the full frozen protocol over a UNIX socket (HELLO/OPEN/ENC_FRAME/ENC_SET/FLUSH/CLOSE, two clients, client killed mid-session, decoder E_UNSUPPORTED, malformed/oversized datagrams, 10000 random datagrams, guest stop in-request and watchdog, HW timeout, clean SIGTERM) in ASan+UBSan -O1 and -O2, plus a second binary linked against IVs real libn2vhost.a and the phone vendor set (OPEN answers E_GUEST/UNDEF at IVs M-b, daemon keeps serving and stops cleanly).

Two decisions I need from you:

1. Client DMA PA (first phone blocker). V41 now accepts a pa-only registration, n2vc_dma_guest_register(h, NULL, handle, pa, bytes, NULL), plus n2vc_dma_guest_forget. The client gets pa from RWVC_DMA_ALLOC, vcodecd only receives the handle in N2VCD_ENC_FRAME, so it cannot fill V41s registry. My earlier proposal stands: add RWVC_DMA_INFO (handle -> pa/bytes on minor 0, same access rule as RWVC_DMA_RW) to include/redwood_vcodec.h + K02/IK. Until it exists a real VENC session answers E_ARGS for every frame; vcodecd logs the gap once. If you prefer a different source of PA, say which and I will code it; I did not invent an ioctl outside the frozen header.

2. iOS vcodecd link. IV produces no arm64 archive and its make ios currently compiles 20/33 objects; the 13 failures are missing SDK headers/constants in IV/V41 sources (ctype.h, fenv.h, setjmp.h, sched.h, strings.h, sys/mman.h, inttypes.h, EPROTO, ENOSYS, SEEK_END), not daemon code. build_ios.sh links vcodecd automatically when N2VHOST_IOS_LIB points at an archive; it prints object-only today. I did not add fake SDK headers because wrong fenv/setjmp ABI would be worse than no binary. Needs IV to provide the archive (and the headers added to gpu/video/sdk or to their own iOS build).

Also still missing: P03 client/** (no n2vcd_cli, no n2vc_hw_open_dev). My build script already compiles client/*.c and links the non-main objects into vcodecd when it lands; the host real test uses a test-only -ENODEV definition.

Full state, outputs and not-done list: gpu/hwcodec/dsh-state/workers/IP/STATUS.md and install/LAYOUT.md section 6.
